title: homerun2-scout-profile chart
_comment: additionalProperties left open so the catalog verifier (call-argocd-verify-catalog) can inject its common probe values like `destination` without tripping the schema. The chart only consumes `name` and `spec`.

name.description: ScoutProfile name; must match SCOUT_PROFILE_NAME of the scout Deployment (base default: default).

alerting._comment: pitcherToken is rejected: a token in a CR ends up in git. apps/homerun2/install passes it as ALERT_PITCHER_TOKEN from a Secret.

pitcherURL.description: omni-pitcher base URL; scout posts to <pitcherURL>/pitch.

digest.description: Periodic digest scout pitches through alerting.pitcherURL (scout v0.11+).
